items.title: What India Won't Admit About the Mind | NIMHANS-trained Neurologist Dr. Ameya Patwardhan
items.description:
Guest: Dr. Ameya Patwardhan, NIMHANS-trained neurologist and cognitive neurologist at Western University (London, Ontario). A Curious Nobody conversation on what India still won't say out loud about the mind: why stigma does more damage than the disease, the 2000 km trip to NIMHANS, and why psychiatrists are leaving. Plus the hopeful part, super-agers.

items.description:

items.description:
This is a short cut from my upcoming full conversation with Dr. Ameya Patwardhan — a NIMHANS-trained cognitive neurologist (Parkinson’s & dementia).
